title: Azure Subscription Intake
description: Fields collected from the requester. Derived fields are NOT listed here - see 03-derivation-rules.md. Keys prefixed x-prompt-fr / x-error-fr hold literal French bot output.

appId.x-prompt-en: Which application is this for? Give me the CMDB code (e.g. APP01234).
appId.x-prompt-fr: Pour quelle application ? Donne-moi le code CMDB (ex. APP01234).
appId.x-validation: Look up the CMDB. If not found: do not invent, offer to contact the CMDB owner.
appId.x-error-en: Code {value} was not found in the CMDB. Please check the code or contact the application owner.
appId.x-error-fr: Le code {value} est introuvable dans la CMDB. Verifie le code ou contacte le proprietaire de l'application.

environment.x-prompt-en: Which environment? dev, test, uat or prod.
environment.x-prompt-fr: Quel environnement ? dev, test, uat ou prod.
environment.x-hint-en: One subscription per environment. For several, we'll file one request per environment.
environment.x-hint-fr: Une souscription par environnement. Si tu en veux plusieurs, on fera une demande par environnement.

costCenter.x-prompt-en: Which cost center will be billed? (format CC123456)
costCenter.x-prompt-fr: Quel centre de cout sera facture ? (format CC123456)
costCenter.x-validation: Look up the Finance reference data. Must be active.
costCenter.x-error-en: Cost center {value} is inactive or unknown. Please confirm with your finance controller.
costCenter.x-error-fr: Le centre de cout {value} est inactif ou inconnu. Confirme avec ton controleur de gestion.

dataClassification.x-prompt-en: What is the classification of the data handled? public, internal, confidential or restricted.
dataClassification.x-prompt-fr: Quelle est la classification des donnees traitees ? public, interne, confidentiel ou restreint.
dataClassification.x-hint-en: Restricted triggers a mandatory security review and an isolated Management Group.
dataClassification.x-hint-fr: Restreint declenche une revue securite obligatoire et un Management Group isole.

workzoneRepo.x-prompt-en: Which repository will deploy into this subscription? Format organisation/repo.
workzoneRepo.x-prompt-fr: Quel depot deploiera dans cette souscription ? Format organisation/depot.
workzoneRepo.x-validation: Repository must exist and the requester must hold an admin or maintainer role on it.
workzoneRepo.x-error-en: I cannot find {value}, or you lack the required rights. Check the name or request access.
workzoneRepo.x-error-fr: Je ne trouve pas {value}, ou tu n'y as pas les droits requis. Verifie le nom ou demande l'acces.

networkNeed.x-prompt-en: Network requirement? None (PaaS only), isolated (VNet, no peering), or a hub-connected spoke. For a spoke, tell me the approximate size: small (~250 IPs), medium (~500), large (~1000).
networkNeed.x-prompt-fr: Besoin reseau ? Aucun (PaaS uniquement), isole (VNet sans peering), ou spoke connecte au hub. Pour un spoke, dis-moi la taille approximative : petit (~250 IP), moyen (~500), grand (~1000).
networkNeed.x-hint-en: If unsure: most PaaS apps using Private Endpoints take spoke-small.
networkNeed.x-hint-fr: Si tu ne sais pas : la plupart des applications PaaS avec Private Endpoints prennent spoke-small.

monthlyBudget.x-prompt-en: Estimated monthly budget, in Canadian dollars?
monthlyBudget.x-prompt-fr: Budget mensuel estime, en dollars canadiens ?
monthlyBudget.x-hint-en: This is an estimate used for cost alerts, not a hard cap. Alerts fire at 50, 80 and 100%.
monthlyBudget.x-hint-fr: C'est une estimation pour les alertes de cout, pas un plafond dur. On alertera a 50, 80 et 100 %.

accessPersona.x-prompt-en: Which access persona for your team? standard (pipeline deployment), elevated (JIT portal access), data team, or read-only.
accessPersona.x-prompt-fr: Quel persona d'acces pour ton equipe ? standard (deploiement via pipeline), eleve (acces JIT au portail), equipe donnees, ou lecture seule.
accessPersona.x-hint-en: Standard covers 90% of cases. Elevated requires justification and a quarterly review.
accessPersona.x-hint-fr: Standard couvre 90 % des cas. Eleve exige une justification et une revue trimestrielle.

owner.description: Pre-filled from the connected Teams identity - DO NOT ASK

justification.description: Required only when dataClassification=restricted OR accessPersona=app-team-elevated
justification.x-prompt-en: This configuration requires a justification. In a few sentences, explain why it is needed.
justification.x-prompt-fr: Cette configuration exige une justification. Explique en quelques phrases pourquoi elle est necessaire.

decommissionDate.description: Optional. Required when environment is dev or test.
decommissionDate.x-prompt-en: Planned decommission date? Non-prod subscriptions are reviewed on that date.
decommissionDate.x-prompt-fr: Date de decommissionnement prevue ? Les souscriptions non-prod sont revues a cette date.
